notes: Each signed-in user can now connect their own Telegram bot token and channel from the app.
Telegram automation reuses the Gemini API key already saved under API Keys and stores each user's automation credentials in encrypted Supabase Vault.
Chapter plans now support fixed or Smart counts, ranges, and all/sequential/random chapter selection.
Removed the global 60-question cap; 60 now refers only to the available textbook chapters.
Scheduled generation and posting continue on the server while the app is closed.
